Duskseam Bracing.name: Duskseam Bracing
Duskseam Bracing.description: The user presses both palms to a collapsing room, stairwell or rubble pile and threads seams of smoked black glass into the cracks. For the rest of the scene that space cannot fall any further, the dark seams cast shade over trapped people, and through the strain in the glass the user feels where each survivor inside lies. The user must keep one palm on the glass and grows parched while holding it. Strain: severe.
